performance.measurement_context: Final int64 guard; same disposable 22-field review row, 100 SQL updates per round, three rounds. Measured while final capability workers ran; compare same-session timings and approximate VM steps, not unrelated machines. Whole-catalog scanning/history growth not introduced.

ordinary-preliminary.explanation: 1437 passes and two old portability assertions failed solely on sender checks vs receiver null. Domain fields matched. Tests now assert local checks separately.

packaging-preliminary.explanation: Both installed variants failed old sender-check equality. Exact six-group comparison found only local last_checked differences. Imported expectations corrected; backup/restore and reindex equality retain timestamps.

ordinary-interrupted.explanation: Deliberately interrupted after the independent int64 SQL finding required a final source/DDL/certificate change; this partial run establishes no final acceptance.

ordinary-interrupted-after-int64.explanation: Deliberately interrupted after 1105 passing cases when malformed Graph proof times exposed an exception-containment defect; source/certificate recaptured after correction. No final acceptance claimed.

pagination_before_optimization.reason: Nested 101-thread by 101-comment sync exceeded unchanged 60-second subprocess deadline.

hosted.policy: Record exact published HEAD, tested merge/tree, hosted run and downloaded selection/JUnit reconciliation without a self-referential source commit.

residual_decisions: Physical body and collection-receipt retention/automatic deletion policy remains deferred. No GC or deletion propagation added.
CAS-76/CAS-77, archive deletion, comprehensive deletion propagation and non-Linux restore remain deferred.
